question:
Choose the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The young athletes __bore the palm__ in almost all the events.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Won.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An idiom is a group of words, or in other words, a phrase that has a meaning different from the literal meaning of the words in it. 
 
 
• Example: "Under the weather" means feeling ill or getting a cold.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "bore the palm" means to win or come out on top**.
 
 
• Example: Sima bore the palm in chess.
 
 
 
• The young athletes won __almost all the events.
 
• The word "bore" is the past tense of "bear" which means to endure or carry a weight.(उठाना)
 
• The word "palm" in this context refers to the palm branch that was traditionally given as a symbol of victory.(हथेली)

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) Compromised: This means to settle a disagreement by making concessions. (समझौता)
 
• Option 2) Lost: This means to be defeated or to not win. (खोया)
 
• Option 4) Fixed: This means to arrange or manipulate something dishonestly. (स्थिर)
